snippet.title: NetherWorld | Official Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
🍸 NetherWorld – Official Demo Trailer 🍸
Vodka. Violence. Very bad decisions. Welcome to the party.

Get ready to descend into the pixelated chaos of NetherWorld — a dark, absurd, and depraved action-adventure where heartbreak meets hangover.
The free demo is now live on Steam and Nintendo Switch as part of Steam Next Fest (starting May 27th)!

Play as Medoo, a sentient jellyfish with a broken heart and a dangerous craving for booze, bullets, and questionable company.
From drunken minigames to roguelike dungeons, shootouts, filthy bosses, and pixelated lust, NetherWorld is as hilarious as it is unhinged.

Steam demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/672420/NetherWorld/

🧠 Features of the Demo:
💔 A twisted story of heartbreak, degeneracy, and redemption
🍻 Drinking contests, erotic shootouts, and roguelike madness with Tick Joe
👊 Brutal boss fights and chaotic combat
🎨 Grotesque pixel art that punches you in the moral compass
🎭 A disturbingly funny take on loneliness, failure, and recovery

🎮 Wishlist NetherWorld now on Steam and Nintendo Switch
🕹️ Play the demo during Steam Next Fest – only for a limited time!

#NetherWorldGame #SteamNextFest #IndieGames #PixelArt #DarkHumor #NetherWorldDemo #HungryPixel #DepravedGamesDoneRight
